one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话区查看 DeepSeek 余额与会话费用
one_liner.en: View DeepSeek balance and session costs in the DSH web composer

api_keys.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
api_keys.purpose: Official and proxy balance queries use this credential reference; manual balance mode uses a local ledger instead.

accounts: DeepSeek account when using official balance mode

external_services.purpose: Fetch official account balance using the configured credential.
Fetch the official pricing page to refresh model token prices.

local: Runs in the DSH web host and client; manual balance accounting requires a writable DSH settings provider.

config_items.name: source
config_items.description: Choose official, proxy-compatible, or manual balance.

config_items.name: apiKeyEnv
config_items.description: Credential reference used for provider balance queries.

config_items.name: baseUrl
config_items.description: API base URL; custom hosts are classified as proxy when source is omitted.

config_items.name: proxyBalancePath
config_items.description: Dot path to a numeric balance in a non-compatible proxy response.

config_items.name: proxyCurrency
config_items.description: Currency for a numeric proxy balance.

config_items.name: refreshIntervalSeconds
config_items.description: Minimum interval between provider balance queries.

config_items.name: enabled
config_items.description: Enable host routes and the browser readout.

config_items.name: model
config_items.description: Composition setting to detect flash/pro from each session or force a preset.

config_items.name: cost
config_items.description: Composition-only per-million-token price and currency overrides.

completeness.reason: Official, proxy, and manual balances, session pricing, browser display, and configuration paths are implemented; judged from the host and client implementations.

code.reason: Typed modules separate host service, routes, pricing, cost math, and UI; validation, caching, and fallback paths are explicit.

docs.reason: README covers installation, requirements, configuration, balance modes, cost estimation, and troubleshooting.

maintenance.reason: Repository signals show 11 commits, but its last push was over 30 days before this analysis; no ongoing recent cadence is visible.

tests.reason: A focused service test file covers balance parsing, ledger persistence behavior, and redaction; no CI workflow is present in the extracted facts.

quality.notes: The quality_raw signals report one test file, no CI or lint configuration, TypeScript, and 11 commits.
